newsitem.title: JAPAN: Asahi Bank to appoint new president, chairman.
newsitem.headline: Asahi Bank to appoint new president, chairman.

text.p: Asahi Bank Ltd said on Tuesday that it would appoint a new president and chairman to cope with Japan's "Big Bang" financial reforms.

Tatsuro Ito, one of the bank's two deputy presidents, will replace Shigehiko Yoshino as president, while the other deputy president, Tadashi Tanaka, will replace chairman Kosuke Yokote, Asahi said in a statement.
The personnel change will be formally approved at the bank's board meeting in June, Asahi said.

"As of the end of March we had nearly completed the handling of our problem loans and we can hand over operations (to new people) when the bank is back on solid footing. It would be better for young forces to proceed with the Big Bang," Yoshino said in a news conference.
